def transform(grid):
    """Reconstruct a cyclic table whose diagonal duplicates the prior entry."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0})
    n = len(colors)
    # The unshifted sequence begins at row 1, column 0; colors wrap at the
    # largest palette value back to the smallest.
    anchor = grid[1][0]
    start = colors.index(anchor)
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        row = []
        for c in range(w):
            if r == 0:
                # Row zero begins with the predecessor of the sequence anchor.
                idx = start - 1 if c == 0 else start + c - 1
            else:
                # At and to the right of the diagonal, shift one place left,
                # causing the diagonal cell to repeat the previous color.
                idx = start + (c if c < r else c - 1)
            row.append(colors[idx % n])
        out.append(row)
    return out
